program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}
    boxes = {}
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        boxes[color] = (r0, r1, c0, c1)
    def is_frame(color, box):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=box
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2: return False
        return (all(grid[r0][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                all(grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                all(grid[r][c0] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1)) and
                all(grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1)))
    sources=[]
    for color,box in boxes.items():
        if is_frame(color,box):
            r0,r1,c0,c1=box
            if any(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)):
                sources.append((color,box))
    if not sources:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The patterned frame is the largest framed object containing interior marks.
    source,box=max(sources,key=lambda item:(item[1][1]-item[1][0]+1)*(item[1][3]-item[1][2]+1))
    r0,r1,c0,c1=box
    pattern=[[grid[r][c] == source for c in range(c0+1,c1)] for r in range(r0+1,r1)]
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color,other in boxes.items():
        if color == source:
            a,b,x,y=other
            for r in range(a,b+1):
                for c in range(x,y+1): out[r][c]=grid[r][c]
        elif is_frame(color,other) and (other[1]-other[0],other[3]-other[2]) == (r1-r0,c1-c0):
            a,b,x,y=other
            for c in range(x,y+1): out[a][c]=out[b][c]=color
            for r in range(a,b+1): out[r][x]=out[r][y]=color
            for i,row in enumerate(pattern):
                for j,marked in enumerate(row):
                    if marked: out[a+1+i][x+1+j]=color
    return out
'''
program_path=base/'programs'/f'{task}.py'
program_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
program_path.write_text(program)
exec(program,globals())
print(program_path)
